$description: Official Luxtory logo kit (received 2026-09-25, upload 53c4a5c). Files are kept byte-for-byte as supplied; code and docs refer to them ONLY through these canonical keys. sha256 pins each file (scripts/brand.test.mjs). Use as (or CSS background) — never inline: the SVGs carry mix-blend-mode:lighten and the icon files hide the wordmark outside their viewBox.

horizontal/moroccan-blue.use: Header and footer on paper/wash. Canonical horizontal lockup.

horizontal/warm-sand.use: Header on night, overlay header over Opening Frames (with scrim), mobile menu.

vertical/moroccan-blue.use: Brand moments on paper/wash (closings, confirmation scenes).

vertical/warm-sand.use: Footer and brand moments on night.

icon/moroccan-blue.use: Favicon, avatar, header below 360px viewport, spaces narrower than 120px — on paper/wash.

missing.horizontal/pure-white: Not supplied. Over photography use horizontal/warm-sand on a scrim ≥ 68% until Luxtory decides.
